title: Vancouver-based quantum computing startup Photonic raised an additional $70M after a $130M raise announced in January, giving it a $2B post-money valuation (Josh Scott/BetaKit)
summary: Josh Scott / BetaKit: Vancouver-based quantum computing startup Photonic raised an additional $70M after a $130M raise announced in January, giving it a $2B post-money valuation — Vancouver-based Photonic has completed the final close of its latest funding round, securing another $70 million USD ($95 million CAD) …
